en.t: His physical strength was still abundant.

units.source_text: 对局前后，在对局室以外的地方同棋手会面是不合适的。

en.t: It was inappropriate to meet with the player anywhere outside the game room before or after the match.

units.source_text: 这时七段情绪昂扬，像是下定决心要拼搏一番。

en.t: At this moment, the seventh-dan player was in high spirits, as if he had resolved to fight with all his strength.

units.source_text: 说不定他脑子里正考虑凌厉进攻的招数呢。

en.t: Perhaps he was already thinking through sharp attacking moves in his mind.
